steps.name: Gifts and Cookies (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Aurum] in “Sanctuary Eidos,” go to [Platina] in “Moros.”

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: … Whoa.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aurum, why are you worried?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer. Didn't he die?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I wanted to come here again.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: You said so. My job is no big deal. You don't have to worry about it. Whoa… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me because I care a lot.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: That's not it, the elders are planning to give something like a gift to junior Platinum this time! You ask me to choose that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does Aurum choose that?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I mean! If you give it away and the awkward relationship becomes irreparable... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … My relationship with Platinum is awkward.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's because we can't run wild together. Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So why not just ask and give them what they like?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'd like to do that too, but I can't leave the sanctuary for the time being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: … He told me not to leave until I picked out a gift. Hey, Adventurer… . Can you help me, who was on a rampage with me?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I know where junior Platinum is. sorry!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It can't be helped. Where is Platinum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Junior Platinum still remains in the Moros region. It seems like they are investigating something further on His Majesty's orders.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's probably near the magic bomb shelter. Then I will go and ask.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Ooh, thank you. As expected, it’s rewarding to run wild together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (While I was there to ask, I had to talk to Platina….)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Uh, Adventurer? How do we get here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Platinum?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, I was fine. Adventurer, how have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are some things going on, but it's okay. I have received a request from Aurum in Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Wait a minute? You're from Sanctuary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Platinum didn't know. therefore… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Platinuma what happened in the sanctuary.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Something like that happened. Thank you for helping senior Aurum and Argent protect the sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: … But what is Senior Aurum’s request?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The elders want to give Platina a gift, but they left the choice to Aurum. But he didn't know what to choose, so I came to ask him instead.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I see. Hmm. gift… . A gift from the Council of Elders… . What would be better?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I never thought about receiving it separately... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ah! That would be nice. A hair tie. I want to tie up my long hair.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I have that as a gift? Don’t you want to get something better?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: What I want is different from the usual. I want to receive what Michaela gives to the Saint Valkyries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What Michaela gives you must be meaningful to the Paladins.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes… . It is given to those who are qualified to receive it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I’m qualified… . Then I will pass it on to Aurum.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I think you have something more to say... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was, but since we were having fun talking about it, I wondered if there was any need to talk about it now.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I'm fine. now… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let me ask you just one thing. What kind of person is your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hehe, this is the most difficult question. You are a person with more complex aspects than other people. You probably know that you have precognitive abilities... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Do you know how His Majesty came to the throne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… . I'm fine... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Then I'll tell you that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: His Majesty the late Emperor intended to continue his line of succession with His Majesty, who was the first princess at the time and is now the Emperor. However, there were forces that opposed the idea of ​​a female royal family ascending the throne rather than a male one.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: That force rebelled on the day of His Majesty's death, but was able to suppress it thanks to His Majesty's foresight.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It is suspected that the Congress is behind the rebels, but no evidence has been found.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Instead, there were rumors. Demons, witches, and the Magic Agency destroyed the evidence... . What the… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It reminds me of a story I heard from Shiina...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Since it's already been 10 years, I think His Majesty is just burying it.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: … Ah, it's already time... . Adventurer, I have some work to do, so I think I should go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go too. I'll talk to Aurum about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You can ask Michaela.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, thank you. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: But I don’t think Michaela will just give it to me… .

steps.name: Gifts and Cookies (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Michaela] in “Hile” and obtain <Green Stem Hair Band>. Then report to [Aurum] in “Sanctuary Eidos.”

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, hello. Greetings from Mika. Even if you enter the sanctuary, nothing will happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Michaela was there too? for a moment… . What you entered into that red space was... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I was bored so I came out for a moment. The cookie here fits Mika’s mouth. Mika, I'll go after eating the cookies.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: How many would you like to pack for you when you leave?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you. I'll eat well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something interesting about this situation. Oh, that's right. I asked Platinum what she would like to receive as a gift.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: (mumbling)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika thinks these cookies are delicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela said she would like to receive the hair tie that is given to Valkyries as a gift.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: That's good. Michaela is here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Michaela... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika's hair tie?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika wants to give it to Platinum if she wants it. But, I can't just give it away.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Because that's a promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Valkyries may just give it to them, but I don't think they give it to humans.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Come to Hillero.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? If it’s Hille… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yes, Hille. Hilleya is the red-colored place where I first met Mika. I'll go and wait.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I want to feel your strength again.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum, I enjoyed the cookies. I'll take what you brought for me. (mumbling)
(As soon as Michaela finishes speaking, she goes outside and spreads her wings. The sight of an angel flying over the sky of Sanctuary Eidos holding a container full of cookies is quite subtle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're saying I have to go there and fight Michaela? To get that... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes… . I think Michaela wants that too.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: What would you like to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'll go first. It will work out somehow. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Then please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then shall we go to Hille…?)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s, are you back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's the hair tie, please take it and give me the platinum one. I'm glad Michaela saw it, it was really hard. After giving this to me, he just disappeared and I couldn't even say hello.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Michaela, it’s been a while since you came. I guess you liked the cookies.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Wow, this… . I feel as much divine power as my blunt weapon, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: This is my birthday present from Gaia. (mumbling)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, is it okay for you to give me something so precious?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: … If Mika wants to give it to someone, it can be made.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Now. I'll give you an Aurum as well.
(Michaela cuts off part of the green stem braid with which she braided her hair. After a while, the part of the stem in Michaela's hand instantly becomes long like a full-grown stem.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Thank you. Hey Michaela!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, Michaela… . You could have just given me that, right?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Come to think of it, I guess so. Michaela, why did you just give it to me?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum gave Mika a cookie. %s, you didn't give me anything, so I applied for sparring instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I should have given you cookies too... . Next time, I'll bring you something like a dessert made by the Monggeul Monggle Guild.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika, I'll wait for you, so bring it to me sometime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. I should have brought you something delicious a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer, come here and eat cookies together. Argent gave me special cookies from Glaston.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: (mumbling)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Delicious!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … But Michaela, do angels eat food too?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: You don't have to eat Mika, but eat the delicious food.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then I have only one place... . Wow, it's delicious. What on earth is it made of? Wow, it's delicious.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: … Ah, I wish I could just eat something delicious like this every day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wouldn't it be best to do it like Aurum? To live without worries... But, I can't do that because I have a lot of work to do...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s just enjoy this moment. Phew….)
